name: Western Packaging
old_description: Western Packaging - FIBC Bulk Bags, Shipping Sacks, Feed Bags for Sale, and More
about:
Western Packaging operates from Albany, Oregon, supplying packaging solutions to agricultural and industrial customers. The company focuses on the production and distribution of flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC), shipping sacks, and feed bags for the farming sector.

The company manufactures high-performance woven polypropylene bags, BOPP bags, woven poly bags, stretch film, and hay sleeves. Its product line includes BRC-certified food-grade bags and FIBC bulk bags designed for seed, grain, and livestock feed. An in-house research and development team works with agricultural plastics and machinery to develop packaging that maintains product freshness and integrity during storage and transport.

Western Packaging serves farmers, contractors, and agricultural operations that need bulk packaging for commodities such as grain, seed, and animal feed. The company also supplies food-grade packaging for processors requiring BRC certification. Customers range from small farms to wholesale distributors seeking reliable bag supply and inventory management support.

Western Packaging emphasizes continuous investment in productivity improvement and efficiency, aiming to deliver dependable results for every operation. The company states that its R&D experience with agricultural plastics and machinery allows it to engineer bags for superior durability and long-lasting use, supporting brand integrity and operational efficiency.
